heroHeadline: Kurdish-Led SDF Formally Dissolves, Merges Into Syrian National Army
heroSubtitle: SDF commander Mazloum Abdi announced at Damascus's presidential palace on August 25, 2026 the dissolution of the Syrian Democratic Forces as an independent military force, completing a phased integration agreed with Damascus in January 2026. The move follows the August 21 completion of Kurdish civil-institution integration, the August 24 US rescission of Syria's State Sponsor of Terrorism designation and delisting of HTS, and an August 18 Israeli airstrike on the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Idlib that strained Israeli-Turkish relations over Syria.
